response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT major_id, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, member_count * 1.0 / AVG(member_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average_group_count FROM major_counts ORDER BY ratio_to_average_group_count DESC LIMIT 10;
